industries.title: Elderly & Disabled Services in the US
industries.one_sentence: Elderly and disabled services providers deliver nonmedical home aide, adult day, companionship, transportation and community support services for older adults and people with disabilities, with demand increasingly tied to Medicaid HCBS policy and the preference to age in place.
industries.market_size: $80.1 billion in 2025

industries.title: Early Childhood Learning Centers
industries.one_sentence: Early Childhood Learning Centers are a labor-heavy, locally regulated education-and-care industry whose 2025 demand is supported by high parental employment and public pre-K funding, but constrained by staffing costs, child-care affordability and demographic softness in young children.
industries.market_size: 2025: about $22.6B in US Early Childhood Learning Centers revenue, per IBISWorld public market-size estimate.
industries.growth: 2019-2024: about 3.6% CAGR for US Early Childhood Learning Centers revenue; 2025: roughly flat near $22.6B based on IBISWorld public summary.

industries.title: Child Education & Developmental Center Franchises
industries.one_sentence: The US child education and developmental center franchise industry has recovered from the 2020 pandemic shock and is around a 2025 market size of about $3.9-$4.0 billion, but growth is modest because tuition hikes, wage pressure and declining births offset strong demand for reliable, curriculum-based care.
industries.market_size: 2025: about $3.9-$4.0 billion for US child education and developmental center franchises, estimated from the 2022 baseline of $3.68 billion and the 2022-2028 projected CAGR of 1.67%, consistent with public franchise-market references around $4.0 billion.
industries.growth: 2022-2025: about 1.7%-2.8% annualized depending on whether the 2022 baseline projection or rounded 2025 public market estimate is used; 2022-2028 baseline projection was 1.67% CAGR.
industries.profit_margin: 2022: 14.5% EBIT margin in the baseline; 2025-2026 margins remain pressured by wages, insurance, rent and compliance costs despite tuition increases.

industries.title: Family Counseling & Crisis Intervention Services in the US
industries.one_sentence: Family counseling and crisis intervention providers deliver nonresidential counseling, support groups, crisis hotlines, family welfare, substance-use support, shelter referrals and related social assistance, with 2025-2026 momentum tied to 988 capacity, CCBHC expansion, block-grant funding and persistent behavioral-health need.
industries.market_size: 2026: $52.4 billion estimated industry revenue in 2021 dollars from the 2022 IBISWorld forecast; broader Census NAICS 6241 Individual and Family Services revenue reached $194.2 billion in 2025 and $49.3 billion in Q1 2026 seasonally adjusted.
industries.growth: 2021-2026: 1.8% forecast CAGR for the IBIS industry; broader Census NAICS 6241 revenue grew 7.5% in 2025 versus 2024 and Q1 2026 seasonally adjusted revenue was 6.5% above Q1 2025.
industries.profit_margin: 2021: 3.5% EBIT margin in the IBIS baseline, reflecting nonprofit reinvestment and labor intensity.

industries.title: Family Planning & Abortion Clinics in the US
industries.one_sentence: US family planning and abortion clinics generated an estimated $3.9 billion in 2025 revenue, with demand supported by contraceptive care, STI testing, Title X and Medicaid reimbursement, while abortion access has shifted sharply toward protected states and telehealth.
industries.market_size: 2025 estimated revenue: about $3.9 billion, derived from the 2022 IBIS baseline of $3.73 billion and its 1.8% 2022-2027 forecast CAGR; latest public Census/FRED NAICS 621410 employer revenue totaled $3.891 billion in 2022 across taxable and tax-exempt firms.
industries.growth: 2022-2027 forecast CAGR: 1.8%; 2022 revenue growth: 1.1%; 2017-2022 CAGR: 2.0%.
themes: Patient travel and state shield laws
Title X and Medicaid policy risk

industries.title: In-Home Senior Care Franchises
industries.one_sentence: U.S. in-home senior care franchises provide nonmedical personal care, companionship, respite care, transportation, meal help and, in some systems, skilled home health services to older adults who want to remain at home.
industries.market_size: 2026 U.S. in-home senior care franchise revenue is estimated near $17.6 billion based on the baseline IBISWorld 2021 forecast; the broader U.S. Elderly & Disabled Services market was $80.1 billion in 2025.
industries.growth: The baseline forecast was 2.6% CAGR for 2021-2026; broader U.S. Elderly & Disabled Services grew 3.4% in 2025, according to IBISWorld public market-size data.

industries.title: Hospices & Palliative Care Centers
industries.one_sentence: US hospices and palliative care centers provide comfort-focused care for terminally ill patients, with revenue anchored by Medicare hospice payments and demand supported by aging demographics, home-based care preferences, and high hospital costs.
industries.market_size: $33.0 billion in 2025
industries.growth: 2.0% CAGR from 2019 to 2024; 2.3% revenue growth in 2024; FY2026 Medicare hospice payment update of 2.6%

industries.title: Home Medical Equipment Rentals

industries.title: Health & Welfare Funds in the US
industries.one_sentence: Health and welfare funds remain a large, mature part of the employment-based benefits system, with revenue supported by rising medical premiums and investment income but constrained by flat union density, insurer competition and higher claims costs.
industries.market_size: 2025 estimated revenue: $258.6 billion, derived from the 2022 IBISWorld baseline of $236.6 billion and its 2022-2027 revenue forecast path to $274.5 billion.
industries.growth: 2022-2027 projected revenue CAGR: 3.0%; 2025 modeled annual growth: about 3.0%.

industries.title: Eating Disorder Clinics
industries.one_sentence: The US Eating Disorder Clinics industry is a small but expanding behavioral health specialty, supported by high unmet need, broader acceptance of telehealth and stepped-care models, and constrained by insurance denials, workforce shortages and high out-of-pocket costs.
industries.market_size: 2025 estimated US revenue: $1.5 billion, based on the 2021 IBISWorld baseline of $1.29 billion and 2021-2026 forecast growth toward $1.4 billion+
industries.growth: 2025 estimated YoY revenue growth: about 2.0%-3.0%; 2021-2026 baseline forecast CAGR: 2.1%
